GH.name: Final withholding tax on dividends paid by resident companies (8 %)
GH.statute: Income Tax Act 2015 (Act 896) s. 115, 119(1)(a), First Schedule para 8(1)(b)(i); s. 115 substituted by Act 1094 (2023) and Act 1134 (2025), para 8 amended by Act 1094 and Act 1134 (dividend rate unchanged); other amending Acts 2016-2020 not all held
GH.doc: s. 115(1): a resident person withholds tax at the para 8 rate when paying a dividend; para 8(1)(b)(i): dividends 8 %; s. 119(1)(a): dividends paid by a resident company are final withholding payments (s. 1(4): taxed at the First Schedule rate, not aggregated).

GH.name: Final withholding tax on rent paid to a resident individual for residential property (8 %)
GH.statute: Income Tax Act 2015 (Act 896) s. 115, 119(1)(b), First Schedule para 8(1)(b)(iv) (Acts 1094, 1134 checked)
GH.doc: para 8(1)(b)(iv): rent paid to an individual for residential property 8 %; s. 119(1)(b): rent paid to a resident individual under a lease of land or a building in Ghana (other than in a letting business) is a final withholding payment. The household's rent is taken as residential.
unsupported: rent for non-residential property at its own para 8 rate
interest paid to individuals (1 %) is not a final withholding payment: not modelled here

SL.name: Final withholding tax on dividends paid to residents (15 %)
SL.statute: Income Tax Act 2000 (as amended to FA 2017) s. 118, 124; First Schedule Part IV as replaced by the Finance Act 2024 (FA 2018-2023 and FA 2025 checked: s. 118, 124 not amended)
SL.doc: s. 118(1)(a): a resident company paying a dividend to a resident withholds at the First Schedule Part IV rate; FA 2024 Part IV: dividends 15 %, interest 15 %, rents 10 %; s. 124: the tax withheld under s. 118 and 119 is final (not aggregated, no refund).
unsupported: dividends to resident companies and complying retirement funds are outside (s. 118(2))

SL.name: Final withholding tax on interest paid to residents (15 %)
SL.statute: Income Tax Act 2000 s. 119, 124; First Schedule Part IV (Finance Act 2024)
SL.doc: s. 119(1)(a): a resident paying interest to a resident withholds at the Part IV rate (15 %, FA 2024); s. 124 (heading 'dividend and interest payments to residents') makes it final — its body speaks of 'a dividend payment ... under sections 118 and 119', hence B.
unsupported: interest paid to resident banks and on Government Development Stocks is outside (s. 119(2))

ET.name: Schedule D dividend income tax (15 %)
ET.statute: Federal Income Tax Proclamation 979/2016 art. 57 as replaced by Income Tax (Amendment) Proclamation 1395/2025 (Negarit Gazette No. 64, 1 September 2025), Schedule D effective 7 August 2025 (art. 4(2))
ET.doc: art. 57(1) (new): a resident deriving a dividend is liable at 15 % of the gross dividend. Before 7 August 2025 the Proclamation 979/2016 rate (10 %) applied: the model applies the rate in force for the tax year from July 2025.
unsupported: the 10 % rate of Proclamation 979/2016 for dividends derived before 7 August 2025

ET.name: Schedule D interest income tax (10 %)
ET.statute: Proclamation 979/2016 art. 56, renumbered art. 58 and replaced by Proclamation 1395/2025, effective 7 August 2025
ET.doc: art. 58(1) (new): a resident deriving interest is liable at 10 % of the gross interest.
unsupported: the earlier 5 % rate on savings deposits under Proclamation 979/2016 art. 56 (before 7 August 2025)

ET.name: Schedule B rental income tax of individuals (0-35 % bands on annual taxable rental income)
ET.statute: Proclamation 979/2016 art. 14(2) as replaced by Proclamation 1395/2025 (applicable to income derived from 8 July 2025, art. 4(3))
ET.doc: art. 14(2) (new): annual taxable rental income 0-24 000 Birr 0 %, 24 001-48 000 15 %, 48 001-84 000 20 %, 84 001-120 000 25 %, 120 001-168 000 30 %, over 168 000 35 %, applied band by band. The household's rent is taken as taxable rental income (the deductions of art. 15 are not applied).
unsupported: deductions from gross rent (art. 15, e.g. the flat deduction for taxpayers not keeping books)
the Proclamation 979/2016 bands for income derived before 8 July 2025

LR.name: Withholding on interest, dividends and rent paid to residents
LR.why: s. 905(b): 15 % on non-exempt interest and dividends paid to residents; s. 905(d): 10 % on rent where annual rent is 70 000 or more — the Code makes neither withholding final (no finality provision found), so they are credits against the personal income tax, not separate taxes
